author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am willing to accept a more automated evaluation harness for the weather feature testing. In exchange, I require that every test case remains fully documented and reviewed before any model change is considered. The speed of the automated runs is less important to me than the rigorous traceability of our validation steps. If we automate the execution but lose the manual documentation layer, I will not approve the change. I am trading the convenience of rapid iteration for the certainty that our governance standards are met without exception.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are trading the convenience of rapid iteration for the certainty of governance standards, indicating a willingness to give up speed in exchange for rigorous traceability.
